mechanics: Obstacle creation (1-hex obstacle tiles): Crushing Grasp bottom, Earthen Bulwark top, Petrify top (on kills), Mud Eruption top (where targets stood), Rock Slide top, Dig Pit top (beside its trap), Rocky End top consume (empty red hexes) and bottom (hexes the pushed target exits), Entomb top consume and bottom

Obstacle destruction as a cost or trigger: Heaving Swing top (push into obstacles) and bottom (destroy or suffer damage 1 for +3 Attack), Rock Slide bottom (Attack X = 2 x destroyed), Stone Pummel bottom (+2 Attack), Meteor top (one Attack 2 per obstacle), Entomb bottom (Ward per obstacle), Wave of Destruction bottom (move through obstacles, +2 Attack each), Earth's Embrace top (push into obstacles), Clear the Way bottom (destroy obstacles, hazardous/difficult terrain and traps entered)
Obstacle relocation: Clear the Way top (move an adjacent 1-hex obstacle within range 4, attack enemies around it)

Counting adjacent obstacles/walls/objectives: Earthen Clod bottom (obstacles or objectives adjacent to the target), Brutal Momentum top (obstacles or walls adjacent to you, +1 Attack and +1 Push each), Earth's Embrace bottom (Heal X = adjacent obstacles)

Friendly fire, damage to allies and enemies alike: Crushing Grasp, Rumbling Advance, Massive Boulder, Crater, Rock Slide (+Muddle), Kinetic Assault, Meteor (bottom and consume top), Entomb; allies only: Unstable Upheaval (damage 2), Earthen Bulwark consume (damage 1 + Ward), Solidify bottom (ally suffers 1 for Shield 2)
Effects on allies in the red hexes of the attack: Dirt Tornado (Muddle), Cataclysm (Immobilize), Sentient Growth (Heal 2), Rocky End (Heal 5)
Ward (2e condition): Earthen Bulwark top consume, Blunt Force bottom consume, Kinetic Assault bottom, Entomb bottom
Trap creation: Dig Pit top (damage 2 + Stun trap)

Use-slot persistent cards: Opposing Strike bottom (end of this and next four turns Heal 2 range 3, 5 slots, XP on 1/3/5), Backup Ammunition top (+1 Target on single-target ranged attacks, 4 slots, XP on 2/4), Brutal Momentum bottom (start of next four turns Move 3 + +3 Attack next melee attack, 4 slots, XP on 2/4)
Persistent without slots: Stone Pummel bottom, Earth's Embrace bottom
Round effects: Heaving Swing bottom, Meteor top consume (your ranged attacks splash damage 1), Solidify bottom, Kinetic Assault bottom
X values: Rock Slide bottom (2 x destroyed obstacles), Wave of Destruction top (range to each target) and bottom (2 x obstacles destroyed by the move), Earth's Embrace bottom (adjacent obstacles)
Consume that changes targeting: Unstable Upheaval top (all enemies up to two hexes away instead of all adjacent); target all enemies moved through: Burrow bottom consume
Kill trigger: Petrify top (XP 1 + obstacle per kill)
Earth is the only element: infused on 13 halves, consumed on 21
'!' boxes: most damage rows, ally-condition rows and every infusion and corner box are printed in a box with a '!' tab
